neighbours.label: going beyond a target, goal or expectation (exceeded, above and beyond, ahead of schedule, and more, surpassed), as against meeting it, falling short, or literal height
fire: Thanks to good weather the harvest came in three weeks ahead of schedule.
Our waiter went above and beyond to find a gluten-free dessert.
The charity outdid its target and raised twice what it hoped.
The concert was everything the fans had dreamed of and more.
Last quarter the company's profits far exceeded analysts' forecasts.
The rookie surpassed every goal the coach had set for him.
The new tunnel opened a full year ahead of schedule.
The volunteers went above and beyond during the flood clean-up.
quiet: Thanks to good weather the harvest came in on the expected date.
Our waiter brought the menu and a basket of bread to the table.
The charity reached its target and raised what it hoped.
The concert started at eight and the fans sang along.
Last quarter the company's profits matched analysts' forecasts.
The rookie met every goal the coach had set for him.
The new tunnel opened on the date the city had announced.
A kite floated high above the roofs during the flood clean-up.
